column2: I always thought I would visit the forest of the legend someday...{wait}{clear}
But I feel that I must go now.{wait}{clear}
Would that be all right?{wait}{clear}
Yes, of course it's all right.{n}
Not right now...{n}
All right. If you say so, Cecia, let's go to the forest.{wait}{clear}
Thank you, Angel.{wait}{clear}
Could we leave it for another time?{wait}{clear}
Besides, right now I would like you to focus on the mission I gave you...{wait}{clear}
Angel...{wait}{clear}I know I'm being selfish, but I feel I must go now.{wait}{clear}
I'm sorry, Angel. I am going to the Forest of the Holy Mother.{wait}{clear}
I see... very well.{wait}{clear}
Past here should be the Forest of the Holy Mother...{wait}{clear}!{wait}{clear}

And that child just now... I can't believe anyone could get this far into the Forest of the Holy Mother.{wait}{clear}Holy Mother, don't you know something? What on earth is happening? Could it be that your...{wait}{clear}
Holy Mother
What is your name?{wait}{clear}
Oh, my name is Cecia.{wait}{clear}
Cecia... Is the one with you not an angel?{wait}{clear}
Yes... that's right...{wait}{clear}

An angel coming down to this world, and you serving that angel, is proof that signs of turmoil have appeared in this world...{wait}{clear}And as you suspect, my power... the power that protects this forest, has surely weakened. That is why I let the monsters in...{wait}{clear}But... I can still...{wait}{clear}
Holy Mother...{wait}{clear}
Cecia, do not worry for now; serve the angel. But if anything happens, you may come here at any time.{wait}{clear}
Yes... I understand, Holy Mother.{wait}{clear}
So this... is the sea...{wait}{clear}
The water really goes on forever...{wait}{clear}
It's beautiful...{wait}{clear}
I wonder if the Holy Mother ever saw this view...{wait}{clear}
Angel! May I go swimming?{wait}{clear}
I want to see if I can swim in the sea just like in a river or a lake.{wait}{clear}
This feels wonderful...{wait}{clear}
Won't you swim too, Angel?{wait}{clear}
Yes, I'll swim.{n}
Swimming isn't for me...{n}
Since we're here, let's have a little swim.{wait}{clear}
Then let's race and see how far out we can go!{wait}{clear}
I'm going ahead!{wait}{clear}
That was fun... wasn't it, Angel?{wait}{clear}
Someday, when I go back to the forest, I'll tell the village children about this sea...{wait}{clear}
I'm sure they'll want to know what the world outside the forest is like.{wait}{clear}
Please do.{wait}{clear}
Thank you for today, Angel.{wait}{clear}
I was so happy. Spending such a fun time together...{wait}{clear}
I'm sorry; water and I don't get along...{wait}{clear}
I see...{wait}{clear}
I'll see how far I can swim.{wait}{clear}
Here I go!{wait}{clear}
Angel... I heard a terrible rumor... Has something happened to the Holy Mother...?{wait}{clear}To me... no, to everyone who lives in the forest, the Holy Mother is irreplaceable.{wait}{clear}
The Holy Mother is precious to you, isn't she, Cecia?{wait}{clear}
I understand how you feel. Please be careful...{wait}{clear}
I'm sorry to ask again and again, Angel. But if something happens to the Holy Mother, it will be too late...{wait}{clear}Please, let me go to the Forest of the Holy Mother!{wait}{clear}
Not now.{n}
All right.{n}
